_meta.description: Curated slug -> category display-name overrides, consulted by scripts/graph/derive-graph.js ONLY when a registry component carries no category (e.g. its Figma frames sit directly on a category-header page, which the sync cannot attribute). The registry always wins when it carries a category, so each entry self-retires once the Figma pages are reorganized and a re-sync restores the category. Delete entries as they retire.
_meta.remove_when: Figma member pages created under the Form header and components' frames moved onto them; next sync then restores registry categories
_meta._history: 2026-08-13: all 7 entries RETIRED on exactly the condition remove_when named. Figma created the member pages under its 'Form' header, and the sync now attributes checkbox, dropdown-select-default, radio, search, search-dropdown-menu and toggle natively as 'Form'. Two things this exposed: the entries had been inert for a while (the registry always wins), and 'input' had gone stale in a way nothing would have caught, pinning to a form category a slug the registry publishes as an ICON. Kept as an empty map rather than deleting the file, because derive-graph.js reads it and an empty override set is the honest expression of 'nothing needs curating today'.
